claims.claim: MilGo (Ministry of Education socioeconomic scholarship via the Milgapo platform) has 4 tiers for the current cycle: Tier A NIS 12,480, Tier B NIS 10,000, Tier C NIS 7,500, Tier D NIS 5,000. The cycle opens in December.
claims.raw_snippet: המלגה לשנת תשפ"ו הסתיימה והמלגה לשנת תשפ"ז תפתח להגשה ככל הנראה במהלך דצמבר 2026. הזוכים במלגה יקבלו מלגה ללא התנדבות בשווי של עד 12,480 שקלים - וההגשה מוענקת אוטומטית עם סיוע אישי במסמכים דרך מלגהפה פרימיום! לחצו לקבלת רשימת מלגות אישית מתי להגיש דצמבר - ינואר סכום המלגה 5,000 - 12,480 למי מיועדת סטודנטים בלימודי תואר ראשון, מכינה או הנדסאים בשנת תשפ"ז שעות התנדבות מלגת מיל-GO היא מלגה ללא התנדבות!
claims.verified_via: cited page fetched and confirmed to contain "12,480"; snippet replaced with the page's own wording around it

claims.claim: The MALAG-set university tuition ceiling used by the MoD Mimadim LiLimudim scholarship for תשפ"ו is NIS 12,017; where a student's institution charges more than the ceiling, the scholarship covers only up to that ceiling.

Mimadim LiLimudim is graduated, not a flat 100% each year: in every year except the last the student is reimbursed up to 85% of tuition actually paid, capped at the university tuition ceiling (NIS 10,214.45 in תשפ"ו), and in the final year the balance is topped up to 100% of tuition actually paid. The תשפ"ו cycle opens 3.11.25, closes for registration 31.7.26, and documents must be uploaded by 31.8.26.
claims.raw_snippet: החזר כספי שנתי - עד 85% משכר הלימוד האוניברסיטאי בהתאם לכל שנה (בשנת תשפ"ו 10,214.45 ₪). •​ השלמת שכר לימוד - בשנת הלימודים האחרונה תבוצע השלמה ל-100% מימון משכר הלימוד האוניברסיטאי ששולם בפועל.

claims.claim: MoD periphery scholarship (national-priority-area): up to 100% of first-year BA tuition, cap ~NIS 11,653 for תשפ"ה/2025. Eligibility requires living in a priority-area yishuv 5 of 6 years before studies AND being within the post-discharge window: 5 years standard, extended to 10 years for active reservists and lone soldiers. Cannot stack with other periphery scholarships.
claims.raw_snippet: מלגת אזורי עדיפות לאומית: עד 100% משכר לימוד שנה א', תקרה כ-11,653 ש"ח (תשפ"ה). חלון מהשחרור: 5 שנים, ומוארך ל-10 שנים למשרתי מילואים פעילים וחיילים בודדים.

claims.claim: Iron Swords (חרבות ברזל) reservist framework (CHE + MoD, covering תשפ"ה-תשפ"ז, tens of thousands of reservist students): NIS 1,100 one-time grant for 8+ cumulative reserve days since 7.10.2023; additional NIS 2,000 one-time for a reservist parent of children under 14; a one-time tuition grant up to ~NIS 11,653 for 50+ Order-8 days (combat array, 2025 cohort window 27.10.2024-30.9.2025); an 8 credit-unit exemption for 61-99 days; a 10 credit-unit exemption for 100+ days. Iron Swords tuition support and Mimadim LiLimudim cannot be received in the same academic year.
claims.raw_snippet: מתווה חרבות ברזל: מענק 1,100 ש"ח ל-8+ ימי מילואים; תוספת 2,000 ש"ח להורה לילדים מתחת לגיל 14; מענק שכר לימוד עד ~11,653 ש"ח ל-50+ ימי צו 8; פטור 8 נק"ז ל-61-99 ימים, 10 נק"ז ל-100+ ימים.

claims.claim: PEREACH (פר"ח) tutoring grant: ~NIS 7,000 for ~114 tutoring hours, ~NIS 10,000 for ~140 hours, per academic year. (A separate Mifal HaPais community-involvement scholarship pays ~NIS 10,000 for ~130 community-service hours; do not conflate it with PEREACH.) The תשפ"ז cycle opens in September and runs first-come-first-served until ~November, NOT in the May-September cluster. Commitments are audited.
claims.raw_snippet: פר"ח: מענק 7,000 ש"ח לחונכות בסך 114 שעות ו-10,000 ש"ח לחונכות בסך 140 שעות; הרשמה לתשפ"ז נפתחת בספטמבר.

claims.claim: The Student Authority (Ministry of Aliyah and Integration) oleh-student scholarship must be applied for online for every new school year, and its submission dates are fixed calendar dates that repeat every year: new first-semester students until 10 November, continuing students until 1 October, second-semester students until 1 April, and summer-semester students until 15 August.
claims.raw_snippet: Dates of submitting the request Students beginning studies during the first semester: New students – until November 10th – every year* Continuing students – until October 1st - every year Students beginning studies during the second semester: Until April 1st – every year Students beginning studies during the Summer semester: Until August 15th - every year

claims.claim: Adams Fellowship (Israel Academy of Sciences and Humanities): for 2nd-year PhDs in exact sciences, mathematics, and life sciences ONLY (NOT humanities or social sciences). Full tuition + NIS 100,000/year stipend + USD 3,000/year travel; granted for 3 years, extendable by up to 1 (4 max). Application opens October-November, closes early January for the following academic year.
claims.raw_snippet: מלגת אדמס: דוקטורנטים שנה ב' במדעים מדויקים, מתמטיקה ומדעי החיים בלבד; מענק 100,000 ש"ח לשנה + 3,000 דולר נסיעות; ל-3 שנים עם אפשרות הארכה בשנה.

claims.claim: Rothschild Fellowship (Yad Hanadiv) for postdocs abroad after an Israeli PhD has a USD 75,000/year ceiling on OTHER external supplementary funding: receiving more than USD 75k/year of other support makes the applicant ineligible (it is a ceiling on other funding, not a cap on the Rothschild itself).
claims.raw_snippet: Rothschild Fellowship: a ceiling of USD 75,000 per year on other external supplementary funds; exceeding it disqualifies the applicant.

claims.claim: ISEF awards Edmond J. Safra Scholarships each year to 400-500 bachelor's, master's and PhD students on 20 campuses across Israel.
claims.raw_snippet: Each year, ISEF awards Edmond J. Safra Scholarships to 400-500 deserving bachelor’s, master’s and Ph.D. students studying on 20 campuses throughout Israel.

claims.claim: The Rashi Foundation's Katzir program funds undergraduate scholarship tracks aimed at single mothers and boarding-school graduates without family support, combining a tuition scholarship with a living stipend. Rashi does not publish per-track amounts, so no amount is asserted.
claims.raw_snippet: בנוסף למלגת שכר לימוד ומלגת קיום, הם זוכים לליווי אישי, לתמיכה לימודית, רגשית ואף חומרית לפי הצורך

claims.claim: IMPACT! (Friends of the IDF / FIDF) is a privately-funded scholarship for former combat and combat-support soldiers from low-income backgrounds: USD 4,000/year for up to 4 years, conditional on ~130 community-service hours per year plus two donor thank-you letters per year.
claims.raw_snippet: IMPACT! provides a USD 4,000 annual scholarship for four years to former combat and combat-support soldiers from low-income families, who commit to about 130 hours of community service per year.

claims.claim: Mimadim LiLimudim pays up to 85% of university tuition in each year of study (10,214.45 NIS in תשפ"ו), with a top-up in the FINAL year of study bringing the total to 100% of tuition actually paid. It is not limited to years 1-2.

claims.claim: The Mimadim eligibility window is 5 years from discharge, extended by 1 year (to 6) for bagrut completion, mechina or psychometric within those 5 years; by 2 years (to 7) for continuous career service of a year or more; and by 3 years (to 8) for both.
